authorship: 教材词头与中文释义由用户提供的 A1 总词汇表逐条转录并对齐；既有 40 词开发集保留其人工编写内容。新增词条从离线开放词典快照提取简短 EN/ES 核心义、词性、IPA 和词形。法语例句保持原内容，中文例句译文由法语原句生成后纳入离线快照。
review_status: 40-entry seed set independently reviewed; expanded textbook entries and Chinese translations are machine-assisted and schema-validated, pending professional human editorial review
scope: 891 textbook glossary occurrences from pages 213–224, merged into 890 textbook lexemes plus 4 retained seed lexemes; every sense has ZH/EN/ES meanings and every French example has ZH/EN/ES translations; every verb has three indicative tenses with six persons.
not_included: 所有时态/语气/被动语态
新增词条的专业人工逐条审校
pronunciation_policy: fr-FR broad IPA for isolated lemma; common pronunciation selected, not all regional variants. Syllable dots are pedagogical. No invented audio paths: audio_asset is NULL; application may use offline fr-FR TTS according to settings.
grammar_policy: Conjugation form excludes subject pronoun. j’ is stored for elision before a vowel or silent h. Third person combines il/elle/on; aller with on requires agreement according to referent, explained in word forms. être compound uses avoir. Avoir-based bare participles represent forms without a preceding agreeing direct object; preceding-object agreement is outside this beginner table.

academie-etre.checked: être irregular forms; avoir auxiliary; étant/été

academie-aller.checked: aller third group, être auxiliary, irregular present and imperfect, participle agreement

academie-aimer.checked: regular -er model; parler/travailler forms authored using this model

larousse-professeur.checked: professeure feminine; une professeur accepted variant

larousse-femme.checked: feminine noun; woman and wife senses

cnrtl-professeur.checked: professeur pronunciation /pʁɔ.fɛ.sœʁ/ (TLFi pronunciation notation normalized to broad modern IPA)

textbook-a1-chinese-glosses.checked: Chinese definitions aligned to all 891 textbook rows from the saved page OCR, with corrections for OCR noise and core-sense alignment

editorial-chinese-glosses.checked: Chinese equivalents authored for retained seed entries absent from the textbook and for separately represented core senses

google-translate-fr-zh-example-snapshot.checked: Chinese translations generated from the existing French examples on 2026-09-10; French examples were not changed

kaikki-enwiktionary.checked: French POS, concise English glosses, IPA, inflection and conjugation facts

espeak-ng-g2p.checked: offline fallback IPA generation for entries without dictionary IPA

editorial-bridging-glosses.checked: short EN/ES equivalents authored for textbook phrases and names missing from the open snapshots
